Due to a systemic failure to implement basic security principles, we gained nearly total control over the infrastructure supporting the development and commercial operations of the entire corporate group. We conducted a methodical and comprehensive review of the documentation, exfiltrating a vast amount of data. We remained undetected for as long as necessary to secure everything we sought.
